history.content: When is a player in an offside position?
A player is in an offside position if any part of the head, body or feet is in the opponents' half and nearer to the opponents' goal line than both the ball and the second-last opponent [p. 103].
How is a penalty kick taken?
The ball is placed on the penalty mark and the kicker is identified; the goalkeeper must remain on the goal line until the ball is kicked [p. 129].
What happens when a player gets a red card?
A player who is sent off must leave the field of play and the technical area [p. 117].
